requisitiHome: Accept the privacy notice and save an OpenRouter key to open your home.

informativa.dati: We read your Gmail messages and store their text and headers encrypted while the mailbox stays connected.
informativa.modelli: Email text goes to AI models through OpenRouter with your key, only to providers that keep no data.
informativa.conservazione: Disconnecting a mailbox or deleting your account removes everything derived from it.
informativa.limitedUse: The use of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

chiave.spiegazione: All AI analysis runs on your own key. It's stored encrypted and never shown in full.
chiave.consiglio: Tip: use a key just for this app, with a credit limit. Whether OpenRouter logs requests is up to your OpenRouter account settings.

esiti.credito_esaurito: The key is valid but has no credit left.
esiti.errore_temporaneo: OpenRouter couldn't be reached. Try again in a moment.
esiti.formato_non_valido: This doesn't look like an OpenRouter key.

contesto.spiegazione: Tell the AI what matters to you: important senders, what's urgent, what's just News. You can change this later in Settings.

esiti.troppo_lungo: The AI context can be at most 20,000 characters. Shorten it and save again.
esiti.vuoto: Write at least one directive, or keep the default ones.

importazione.spiegazione: We analyse the last 14 days of received mail and 30 days of sent mail.
importazione.stima: {numero, plural, one {# email} other {# emails}} · about {costo}
importazione.requisiti: Accept the privacy notice and save a valid key first (steps 1–2).
